[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (operations: List Int) : Bool :=
let rec loop (ops: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool) : Bool :=
  match ops with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_balance := balance + head
    let new_result := if new_balance < 0 then true else result
    loop tail i.succ new_balance new_result
loop operations 0 0 false
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation operations
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  by_cases h_result: result
  -- if result then
  simp [h_result]
  have h_balance_condition := loop_becomes_true operations
  simp [h_balance_condition]
  exact h_balance_condition
  -- if ¬result then
  simp [h_result]
  have h_balance_condition := loop_never_becomes_true operations
  simp [h_balance_condition]
  exact h_balance_condition
[END]

lemma loop_becomes_true (ops: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool)
  (h_balance_condition: ∃ i', i' ≤ ops.length ∧ (ops.take i').sum < 0) :
  loop ops i balance result = true :=
by
  induction' ops generalizing i balance result
  simp at h_balance_condition
  rename_i head tail ih
  by_cases h_head_eq_0: head = 0
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  specialize ih (head + balance) (i.succ) (if head + balance < 0 then true else result)
  rw [ih]
  simp at h_balance_condition
  rename_i i' h_i' h_sum_i'
  have h_sum_i'_lt_0 := h_sum_i'.2
  simp [h_sum_i'_lt_0]
  exact h_sum_i'_lt_0
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  simp [h_head_eq_0] at h_balance_condition
  rename_i i' h_i' h_sum_i'
  have h_sum_i'_lt_0 := h_sum_i'.2
  simp [h_sum_i'_lt_0]
  have h_i'_lt_ops_len := h_i'.1
  simp [h_i'_lt_ops_len]
  simp [loop]
  exact h_sum_i'_lt_0
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  simp [h_head_eq_0] at h_balance_condition
  rename_i i' h_i' h_sum_i'
  have h_sum_i'_lt_0 := h_sum_i'.2
  simp [h_sum_i'_lt_0]
  have h_i'_lt_ops_len := h_i'.1
  simp [h_i'_lt_ops_len]
  simp [loop]
  exact h_sum_i'_lt_0

lemma loop_never_becomes_true (ops: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool)
  (h_balance_condition: ∀ i', i' ≤ ops.length → (ops.take i').sum ≥ 0) :
  loop ops i balance result = false :=
by
  induction' ops generalizing i balance result
  simp at h_balance_condition
  rename_i head tail ih
  by_cases h_head_eq_0: head = 0
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  simp [h_head_eq_0] at h_balance_condition
  specialize ih (head + balance) (i.succ) (if head + balance < 0 then true else result)
  simp [ih]
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  exact h_head_eq_0
  simp [h_head_eq_0] at h_balance_condition
  specialize ih (head + balance) (i.succ) (if head + balance < 0 then true else result)
  simp [ih]
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  exact h_head_eq_0
  simp [h_head_eq_0] at h_balance_condition
  specialize ih (head + balance) (i.succ) (if head + balance < 0 then true else result)
  simp [ih]
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  exact h_head_eq_0
  simp [h_head_eq_0] at h_balance_condition
  specialize ih (head + balance) (i.succ) (if head + balance < 0 then true else result)
  simp [ih]
  simp [h_head_eq_0]
  simp [loop]
  exact h_head_eq_0
